title: What If Earth's Gravity Suddenly Doubled?

scenes.text: What if gravity doubled overnight? You would weigh twice as much, but that is not the scary part.
Your bones would be fine. A University of Zagreb study says a skeleton holds up to about ten times Earth gravity.
Your heart is the weak link. Blood pools in the legs, and long-term circulation tops out around four times gravity.
At double gravity you could live, but every stair would feel like carrying a second you on your back.
Athletes would cope far better. The same study says training would make a four-times-gravity world feasible.
Double is survivable. It is not the end of humans. It is the end of ever feeling light again.

description:
What if Earth's gravity doubled?
A University of Zagreb study says bones and muscles could cope up to several times Earth gravity, but your heart is the limit.
What should we run through next?
